resources.string: Sign in to sync your notebooks across devices, or connect viveNotes to a server you control.
Connect to your own viveNotes server.
viveNotes will forget this device\'s token, which the server cannot issue again. Connecting later registers a new device, so remove this one from your server\'s dashboard.
That is not a server address. Try something like https://notes.example.com.
Nothing answered at that address. Check the address and port, and that the server is running.
That email and password do not match an account on this server.
The server would not accept those details. Check the email address, and that the password is at least 8 characters.
Those details are longer than the server accepts.
The server could not complete the request. Check its logs, then try again.
Something answered at that address, but it is not a viveNotes server.
This device\'s access was revoked on the server, so it has been disconnected. Sign in again to register it.
This device registered with the server, but its token could not be saved, so it cannot be used. Free some storage and connect again — the unused device can be removed from the server\'s dashboard.
